name: moqu
description: 墨趣（Moqu）：Web(PWA) 与 Android(BOOX) 双端的离线游戏合集

scripts.build:web: npm --workspace @eink/web run build && node tools/scripts/generate-sw.mjs apps/web/dist
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run check:i18n && npm run build:web && npm run check:docs && npm run check:games
scripts.preview:cf: npm run build:web && npx --yes wrangler dev
scripts.deploy:cf: npm run build:web && npx --yes wrangler pages deploy apps/web/dist --project-name=moqu --branch=main
scripts.explore: node tools/scripts/explore-ui.mjs && node tools/scripts/explore-data.mjs && node tools/scripts/explore-flows.mjs && node tools/scripts/explore-maxscale.mjs && node tools/scripts/explore-landscape.mjs
